title: Archive old Read Later tabs to Readeck
intent: Add an opt-in long-term lifecycle stage now that Readeck is available: save sufficiently old Read Later pages to Readeck, verify remote archival, then close the browser tabs. Keep Rauiri Read Later as the short-term shelf and preserve the no-surprise data-loss contract.

checklist.text: Inspect the installed Readeck API and authentication flow
Define age threshold, selection/confirmation, undo, and failure behavior
Preserve useful title, URL, context, and Read Later metadata
Only close a tab after remote archival has been verified
